serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I’m still thinking about that time we went to these ruins with Shanice and bot…
{f_botName} was very shaken up by it and I have no idea what it means. 
Maybe I should go to Priestbot to ask for advice since he’s sort of a bot too? 
On the other hand, Shanice is still suspicious of him, so I don’t think it would be a good idea after all.
I need to take a breather…
You: I need to go somewhere… I will come back soon.
Bot: Is something wrong?
You: Don’t worry about it. I’m just going for a short walk. That’s all.
Bot: Alright, take care.
